assumptions.choice: Trade the single supplied AAPL 1d feed instead of a screened universe of European equities.
assumptions.reason: The harness provides exactly one AAPL data feed; no European equities data or multi-asset feed is available.

assumptions.choice: Omit the 'liquid stocks with sufficient trading volume' filter.
assumptions.reason: No cross-sectional volume data across multiple stocks is available to define or apply a liquidity threshold.

assumptions.choice: Omit the cross-sectional 'exclude stocks above the 3rd quartile ATR' volatility filter.
assumptions.reason: This filter requires computing ATR quartiles across a universe of stocks; only one instrument is fed to the strategy, so no cross-sectional quartile can be computed.

assumptions.choice: Treat 'close above SMA(20)' as a state condition re-checked every bar while flat, not a one-time crossover event.
assumptions.reason: The spec does not distinguish crossover vs. state; a state condition is the more literal reading of 'when the price closes above the SMA(20)'.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss and take-profit levels are computed once at entry from the entry price and ATR(14) at that time, and held fixed (not trailed) until exit.
assumptions.reason: The spec says the stop-loss is calculated 'from the entry price', implying a level set once at entry rather than a trailing stop.

assumptions.choice: Use the bar's Low to test whether the stop-loss level was touched and the High to test the take-profit level.
assumptions.reason: Only OHLCV bars are available (no tick/intrabar data), so High/Low are the literal proxies for whether a fixed price level was reached intrabar.

assumptions.topic: exit priority when both levels are touched same bar
assumptions.choice: Check the stop-loss condition before the take-profit condition.
assumptions.reason: The spec states no tie-break order; checking the loss-limiting condition first is the conservative reading for a risk-management-focused strategy.

assumptions.choice: Position size (shares) = 1% of current portfolio value / current close price, passed directly via self.buy(size=...).
assumptions.reason: The spec states position size must be 1% of total trading capital; taken literally as the position's notional value, independent of the accompanying internally-inconsistent loss-percentage narrative in the spec.
